pr_title: Update LiveTradingDataFeed to handle equity auxiliary data
pr_body:
#### Description
This is the first step required to support live equity splits, dividends and delistings.
The new `LiveBaseDataSynchronizingEnumerator` has been added to the live equity enumerator stack.

#### Related Issue
Closes #2104 

#### Motivation and Context
Currently we do not support live equity auxiliary data.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Unit test included for the new enumerator + local and cloud testing with IB.

#### Types of changes
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/ect)

issue_context.title: Add Auxiliary equity data support in LiveTradingDataFeed
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The `LiveTradingDataFeed` does not currently support auxiliary equity data (splits, dividends, delistings).

#### Actual Behavior
Not supported.

#### Potential Solution
Add a synchronizing enumerator capable of synchronizing live equity ticks and live auxiliary data.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: Is there any harm in using the synchronizing enumerator for all security types?
Don't we only have aux data with equities ? Even if the performance hit of the extra enumerator is minimal, I personally prefer to add it only where needed.

sounds good -- just where possible I try not to encode how things 'currently are' in multiple places if not required, because in the (currently unlikely) event that things change, it's just more places that introduce bugs later.
